description: An incremental manifest enumerates every asset the workspace references, marking an unchanged one inherited from its base archive while a newly created one is embedded; the workspace snapshot itself is always full regardless of mode. The embedded entry declares size 4: sha256("test") names exactly those four bytes, and ARC-060 makes the declared size part of the asset table rather than a hint — Create refuses a manifest whose declared size disagrees with the bytes it embeds. The entry carried no size at all until this case became drivable, which is the second defect fixing the truncated digest exposed.
